title: Fleet Operations Console: traffic shaper, throughput heatmap, and change trail
creator: Marina Velasquez
description: Build an operator-focused Fleet Operations view in the Console that combines (1) interactive traffic-shaping controls for per-fleet throughput and burst budgets, (2) a compact throughput heatmap + histogram showing token/sec and tail latency distributions by model and region, and (3) an immutable change trail (audit export and quick-revert) for scaling policy changes. Goal: enable infra and platform teams to safely tune Dedicated fleets for SLA guarantees while seeing immediate cost/latency impact and retaining full auditability.
acceptance_criteria: Traffic shaper UI: operators can set target RPS/tokens-per-second, burst budget, and a schedule for scaling overrides for a fleet
Heatmap visualization: shows 24h token/sec heatmap per model and region with selectable percentile latency overlays (p50/p95/p99)
Policy change trail: every update to fleet scaling or throughput policy appears in the immutable change trail with user, timestamp, diff, and reason fields
Quick-revert: operators can revert the most recent policy change and trigger a canary rollback policy within the same console flow
Cost preview: changing target throughput surfaces an estimated per-hour cost delta using the fleet's current instance mix
Role gating: RBAC respects existing org roles; unauthorized users see read-only views and must complete an approval flow to apply changes
Export: audit trail export to CSV available for the selected time window
E2E test coverage: end-to-end QA exists for editing a policy, observing metric changes, and reverting with a 5-minute smoke validation
engineering_notes: Backend: extend fleet-config API to accept a throughput_budget object {target_tps, burst_tokens, schedule} - ENG impact: small schema migration
Runtime: coordinate with serving runtime team to add a live token-rate annotation endpoint for a fleet (ENG-4122)
Cost calc: use existing billing telemetry to estimate incremental cost; add a conservative multiplier for queued requests
Heatmap: client-side bucketing of token/sec into 5-min buckets; defer GPU-level profiling (future work)
Revert: implement soft-revert via flighted rollout with canary traffic to previous policy, requires rollout orchestration changes (dependency ENG-4278)
RBAC: reuse console's permission checks; add 'fleet.policy.edit' and 'fleet.policy.revert' scopes

qa_plan: Create synthetic traffic jobs that emulate 3 traffic patterns (spiky, steady, diurnal)
Validate that applying a traffic-shaper change results in expected token/sec trajectories within 90s for canary and 5m for full rollout
Confirm cost preview within ±15% of actual bill for a 1-hour sample run
Confirm audit CSV contains user, timestamp, diff, and revert marker
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Heatmap data volume could overwhelm the Console for large fleets. Mitigation: server-side rollup and client sampling; throttle long queries.
Risk: Incorrect cost previews could mislead operators. Mitigation: conservative high-side estimates and clear disclaimer in UI.
Risk: Revert automation could trigger unintended churn. Mitigation: require canary validation and a 2-step confirmation for automated revert actions.
